name: T.V. Today Network Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, T.V. Today Network operates mainly in television broadcasting and other media operations[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TVTN is promoted by the India Today group. The company broadcasts 24-hour news channels viz. Aaj Tak, Good News Today and Aaj Tak HD in Hindi, and India Today Television in English. TVTN acquired the digital operations business of Living Media India Limited and has further added new properties. The digital business comprises Aaj Tak and India Today websites, along with the various social media and online video channels.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.95 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 196%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 165 days to 104 days
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.98% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.28% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.37.6 Cr.
